digest.component_or_area: Jira Reconciler three-way merge baseline advance
propositions: A local status change is silently reverted by the reconciler within one pass when the new local value equals the pre-push baseline, because the baseline is advanced from the last-FETCHED snapshot instead of the last-SYNCED value

The guard _suppressed_by_inbound fires falsely: it checks local==baseline to infer no local change, but the baseline lags rebar's own outbound push by exactly one pass, making the premise false for that window

Per-mutation success must gate baseline advance: a soft-failed transition (no legal reverse path, caught by the backstop) must NOT advance the baseline, else rebar records a sync that never happened and masks real divergence
The ABA exposure affects all five inbound-mirrored fields (summary, description, priority, status, assignee) because they all share the _suppressed_by_inbound guard and therefore all share the defect

The fix overlays confirmed outbound mutations onto the pass-start snapshot before set_baseline records it, so the baseline means last-synced rather than last-fetched, with success keyed on per-mutation completion not pass exit code
